(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, a. the finger palette including: i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion; b. the method including the steps of: i. securing the finger palette to a finger; ii. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and iii. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination, wherein the method specifically excludes the surface portion being without protrusions or being planar.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, and wherein the second quantity does not have to be smaller unless specified by the user.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is configured to include optional protrusions extending therefrom.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is not required to be perfectly planar.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger in a manner including but not limited to, passing the finger through the ring portion alongside other attachment methods.
